text: I can't log into my account at all - every attempt shows a server error, and I need access today to finish an urgent task.
The app keeps crashing whenever I try to upload a file larger than 10MB. This happens every time and is blocking a report that's due in an hour.
The export button on the reports page doesn't do anything when I click it. A couple of other people on my team have hit this too - would be nice to have it addressed sometime this sprint.

The search results seem to ignore the filters I've set - I select 'closed' status but open items still show up. It affects a few of us on the team, and we'd appreciate a fix sometime in the next week or two.
I noticed a small typo in the settings page label, it says 'Preferances' instead of 'Preferences'.
We need the ability to export all records in bulk by the end of this week for a compliance deadline - is this already possible or planned?
Would it be possible to add a dark mode option to the dashboard? A few people on our team have asked about it - would be nice to have it addressed sometime this sprint.
Small idea for later: maybe add keyboard shortcuts for navigating between pages.
Could you add support for two-factor authentication at login? We don't need it immediately but would like to see it on the roadmap.
I want to share urgent feedback: the recent pricing change without any advance notice upset several people on our team, and we'd like someone to address this today.

Overall the new interface feels a lot smoother than the old one. A few of us on the team think it'd be worth reviewing some of the remaining rough edges sometime this sprint, though nothing is broken.
Just a small compliment - the support team has been really helpful and quick to respond lately.
